# agent-session-launcher Node binding (vendored)

Unchanged copy of `bindings/node/` (`index.mjs`, `index.d.ts`) and `LICENSE` from
[JevonsCode/agent-session-launcher](https://github.com/JevonsCode/agent-session-launcher)
tag `v0.5.1`, commit `24cabe7b53c08d406951d126c26567825516d29b`.

Do not edit these files: fix the component upstream, release it, then copy the new tag's
binding here and bump the pins in `src/agent-kits/pins.js` in the same change. FULI code
reaches the binding only through `src/agent-kits/session-launcher.js`.
